digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) numbering and indexing
propositions: 17 duplicate ADR numbers exist across 91 files (22 files reused across collision groups), with earliest-landed ADR keeping its number and 22 collision-pair ADRs renumbered to 0070-0091.
Per-number marker files `docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN` (content = filename) prevent future collisions via git add/add conflicts, eliminating racy pre-merge CI checks.

All slug-bearing cross-references to moved ADRs across docs/ and src/ are rewritten to their new 0070-0091 numbers; ambiguous bare-number references are recorded in RENUMBERING.md with resolution tiers.
CI gate (check_adr_numbers.py) enforces bijection between ADRs and marker files, unique numbers, and referential integrity of all `](adr/NNNN-slug)` markdown links.
Generated docs/adr/README.md index groups ADRs by workstream; RENUMBERING.md records old-to-new mapping and per-reference resolution provenance.
